<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that breaks a sulfonamide into an amine and a sulfonyl chloride. Using the functional groups list, we search for templates where the sulfonamide group is broken and an amine and an acyl (sulfonyl) chloride are formed. The target molecule is the sulfonamide product: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonamides"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines", "acyl chloride"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
